title: Subjects with no identity document
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload; QR Code Generation, 12.1 Scenario. QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload: “id is optional precisely because many certificate subjects have no identification document.”.

statements.label: Subjects with no identity document
statements.requirement: The DVCMin model SHALL allow id and dt to be absent and SHALL support gn (parent or guardian) for subjects such as newborns.
